contract.interface:
For a finite Boolean matrix M, r(M) is real rank, pi(M) the number of disjoint positive one-rectangles, and signed length s counts Cartesian rectangles with +/-1 coefficients. The general target pi(M)<=exp(polylog(s+2)) is an existing log-rank reformulation, still OPEN. The source constructs counterexamples to specific local cancellation rules, not to log-rank, arbitrary positive partitions or communication efficiency.

For every integer n,L>=1 it gives r=1+2Ln, signed length s=1+3Ln, and pi<=1+2Ln+n. The signed representation uses linearly independent actual columns in an inclusion-maximal dissociated choice; it does not insert duplicate opposite-sign rectangles. Equal sharing allocates each positive piece as U_i=1_{P_i}M/P. A chosen U_0 contains K(S,T)=1/(1+L|S intersect T|), S,T subsets of[n], with rank exactly 2^n. The source proves K=Z diag(d_|U|) Z^T, d_k=(-1)^k k!L^k/product_{j=0}^k(1+Lj). All diagonal factors are nonzero and their signs alternate: K is not asserted positive semidefinite. At L=8 and max-entry approximation error<=1/9, Sherstov/Paturi machinery gives rank>=2^{Omega(sqrt(n))}. This imported robust bound is superpolynomial, not exponential in n.

The same family has a cheap geometry-aware alternative: cancel each nested v^+-v^- pair first and retain the diagnostic predicates, giving O(n) disjoint positive rectangles for fixed L. A uniform random local priority at L=1 yields selected-label rank 2^{|I|}, mean (2^{n+1}-1)/(n+1), but a chosen global order escapes. A rank-one fixture on subset layers m,m+1 with singleton columns forces binom(2m,m+1) literal atoms, while one threshold predicate handles it. These demonstrate limitations of blind priority and literal-only refinement, not all useful predicates.

For a supplied representation with p positive and q negative rectangles, a general explicit compiler gives pi<=2^q sum_{k=1}^{min(q+1,p)} binom(p,k)<=2^q(q+1)p^{q+1}. Fixed q is polynomial, q=O(log s) quasipolynomial. This is not the general polylog-exponent theorem: q is supplied, and finding a small-negative representation is not free. Explicit-set operations and emptiness tests for succinct sets must be charged. A 4x4 Boolean cycle of rank three leaves rank three or four after removing any nonempty one-rectangle, despite an easy four-rectangle partition. Strictly monotone real-rank greedy progress therefore fails; a valid amortized potential is unproved.

The remaining capability needs global predicate synthesis and amortized control, rather than renaming the unresolved partition problem. The exact finite verifier supports debugging only. N642's Fourier result was read to preserve quantifier discipline; no FEI theorem transfers. OpenAI support/orbit hypotheses were not established. Statements, failures and prior references are source-reported, unreviewed research capital. Independent correctness, historical priority, a new universal mathematical primitive and transformative technological consequences remain UNKNOWN.
